sources.publisher: National Social Security and Welfare Corporation

conditions.label: Has employees
conditions.description: Pays wages or salaries and runs a payroll.

conditions.label: Registered for VAT
conditions.description: Registered for value added tax or a similar turnover tax.

conditions.label: Listed on a stock exchange
conditions.description: Its shares trade on a regulated market.

profileFields.label: Company name
profileFields.description: The registered name, including the Inc. legal form. A joint-stock company that can issue shares.

profileFields.label: Business registration number
profileFields.description: The number the company register gave the company.

profileFields.label: Registered office address
profileFields.description: The address on the company register.

profileFields.label: Share capital
profileFields.description: The capital the company was registered with. Leave it empty if the form has no share capital.

roles.label: Director
roles.description: Sits on the board and runs the company.

roles.label: Officer
roles.description: A senior officer named by the board.

setupSteps.title: Choose and check the Inc. name
setupSteps.description: Check the name is free in Liberia Business Registry (LBR) and follows Liberia's naming rules.

setupSteps.title: Prepare the Inc. documents
setupSteps.description: Prepare the articles or statutes, the founders' details and the registered office. The registration process sets out what it needs.

setupSteps.title: Register the Inc.
setupSteps.description: Submit the incorporation documents as Liberia Business Registry (LBR) requires. The company exists once the register enters it.

setupSteps.title: Register the Inc. for tax
setupSteps.description: Register with Liberia Revenue Authority (LRA) for the company's tax number and any VAT or payroll accounts it needs.

setupSteps.title: Register as an employer
setupSteps.description: Before the first hire, register with National Social Security and Welfare Corporation (NASSCORP) for payroll and social contributions.
setupSteps.authority: National Social Security and Welfare Corporation (NASSCORP)

setupSteps.title: Open a business bank account
setupSteps.description: Banks usually ask for the registration certificate and the tax number.

setupSteps.title: Check licences for your activity
setupSteps.description: Some activities need a permit or a licence from a sector regulator. Check before you start trading.

obligations.title: Annual return or confirmation statement
obligations.description: Check whether an annual return or confirmation statement is due with Liberia Business Registry (LBR), then file it and keep the company record current.

obligations.title: Annual financial statements
obligations.description: Prepare the annual accounts. Check whether they must be filed with Liberia Business Registry (LBR), the deadline and whether an audit is required.

obligations.title: Corporate income tax return
obligations.description: Check the company's income tax filing with Liberia Revenue Authority (LRA), then file the return and pay by the dates it sets.

obligations.title: VAT returns
obligations.description: File VAT returns with Liberia Revenue Authority (LRA) and pay any VAT due. Check whether the company is registered and how often it files.

obligations.title: Payroll taxes and social contributions
obligations.description: Withhold and remit payroll taxes and social contributions for employees through National Social Security and Welfare Corporation (NASSCORP). Check the rates and dates.
obligations.authority: National Social Security and Welfare Corporation (NASSCORP)

obligations.title: Beneficial ownership information
obligations.description: Check whether the country requires a beneficial ownership filing. If it does, keep the record up to date and file it with Liberia Business Registry (LBR).

obligations.title: Report changes to the register
obligations.description: Check what changes must be reported to Liberia Business Registry (LBR), then tell it about changes to the name, address, directors or share capital within its deadline.

obligations.title: Renew licences and permits
obligations.description: Check which licences your activity needs and renew them before they expire.

obligations.title: Annual general meeting
obligations.description: Hold the annual general meeting and record the resolutions.

obligations.title: Audit the annual accounts
obligations.description: Have the annual accounts audited if the company meets the audit threshold.

obligations.title: Disclose market information
obligations.description: Publish information that could affect the share price as the market rules require.
